name: taskade
description: Official Taskade MCP server. Taskade: projects, tasks, AI agents and automations. Remote server with OAuth. The hosted server needs a paid Taskade plan.

TASKADE_API_KEY.description: Taskade personal access token for the local stdio server. The hosted server uses OAuth and does not need it.

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP. Use an OAuth-capable MCP client and sign in to Taskade. Needs a paid Taskade plan.

npm.description: Local stdio. Requires Node.js and a Taskade personal access token.
